name: Katsuragi Kei
source: One grade above the player. Kei is the star actor at "Kiageha", Ootori Academy's prestigious theater troupe. Top-notch acting skills coupled with beautiful features and extraordinary physical prowess has made him a darling of the industry despite still being a student. Kei is also a skilled cook after spending time helping out at his family's restaurant in the countryside.
